# ColumnDescriptor

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Describes a vertical column layout. Provides scoped methods for adding items and configuring spacing. Maps to a `VerticalStack` element internally.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new ColumnDescriptor()
```

## Methods

- [`Item`](#item): Adds an item to the column and returns a container for configuring its content.
- [`Spacing`](#spacing): Sets the vertical spacing between items in points.
